qe: Two charged particles traverse identical helical paths in completely opposite senses within a uniform magnetic field $\vec{B} = B\hat{k}$. Which algebraic relationship must their charge-to-mass ratios satisfy?
qh: दो आवेशित कण एक समान चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $\vec{B} = B\hat{k}$ में विपरीत दिशाओं में समान पेचदार मार्गों (identical helical paths) पर चलते हैं। उनके आवेश-से-द्रव्यमान के अनुपात (charge-to-mass ratio) का योग क्या होगा?
o: $$\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 - \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0$$
$$\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0$$ (आवेश-द्रव्यमान अनुपात का योग शून्य होना)
$$\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 \cdot \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 1$$
$$\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = B$$
e: Explanation: The geometry of a helical path is governed by its pitch: $$\text{Pitch} = \frac{2\pi m v \cos\theta}{eB}$$. For two particles to map out identical helical paths in completely opposite directions within the same uniform magnetic field, their charge-to-mass ratios must be equal in magnitude but opposite in sign, satisfying $$\left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_1 + \left(\frac{e}{m}\right)_2 = 0$$.

qe: According to the Biot-Savart law, what is the spatial vector orientation of the magnetic field $\vec{B}$ generated by an electron moving with a velocity vector $\vec{v}$ relative to that velocity?
qh: बायो-सेवर्ट नियम (Biot-Savart law) के अनुसार, $\vec{v}$ वेग से गतिमान इलेक्ट्रॉन द्वारा उत्पन्न चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $\vec{B}$ की दिशा वेग वेक्टर के सापेक्ष क्या होती है?
o: $$\vec{B}$$ is strictly parallel to the velocity vector $$\vec{v}$$
$$\vec{B}$$ is perpendicular to the velocity vector $$\vec{v}$$ ($$\vec{B} \perp \vec{v}$$)
$$\vec{B}$$ points directly along the linear line connecting the observer
$$\vec{B}$$ follows a completely non-polar open-chain path
e: Explanation: The Biot-Savart law dictates that the magnetic field vector scales with the vector cross product of the current element and the displacement vector ($$\vec{B} \propto I\vec{d}l \times \vec{r}$$). Since the conventional current element flows in the direction opposite to the electron velocity vector ($$\vec{v}$$), the directional cross product guarantees that $$\vec{B}$$ is perpendicular to $$\vec{v}$$.

qe: A current-carrying circular loop sits in the x-y plane. If exactly half of the loop is bent along the diameter to rest vertically in the y-z plane, what happens to the net magnetic dipole moment vector magnitude?
qh: एक धारावाही वृत्ताकार लूप x-y तल में स्थित है। यदि इस लूप के आधे हिस्से को मोड़कर y-z तल में लंबवत व्यवस्थित कर दिया जाए, तो शुद्ध चुंबकीय द्विध्रुव आघूर्ण (net magnetic dipole moment) के परिमाण पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ेगा?
o: The net magnetic moment magnitude doubles over time
The total magnitude of the net magnetic moment diminishes (शुद्ध चुंबकीय आघूर्ण का परिमाण घट जाता है)
The net magnetic moment vector orientation remains completely unchanged
The baseline value drops down cleanly to an absolute zero state
e: Explanation: Initially, the entire loop creates a single magnetic moment $$M = I\pi R^2$$ along the z-axis. Bending half into the y-z plane splits the system into two orthogonal semicircular loops, each carrying a moment of $$\frac{M}{2}$$. The vector sum of these orthogonal moments yields $$M_{\text{net}} = \sqrt{(\frac{M}{2})^2 + (\frac{M}{2})^2} = \frac{M}{\sqrt{2}}$$, which is less than $M$.

qe: An electron is projected with a uniform velocity vector directed precisely along the central axis of a current-carrying long solenoid. What trajectory will the electron follow?
qh: एक इलेक्ट्रॉन को धारावाही लंबी परिनालिका (solenoid) के केंद्रीय अक्ष के समानांतर एकसमान वेग से प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। इलेक्ट्रॉन का मार्ग कैसा होगा?
o: The electron will accelerate along a linear path matching the axis
The electron path will collapse into a highly tight circular loop
The electron will continue to move with a uniform velocity along the axis of the solenoid (एकसमान वेग से अक्ष के अनुदिश गतिमान रहना)
The electron executes an unstable helical path skewed at 45 degrees
e: Explanation: The magnetic field ($$\vec{B}$$) inside a long, current-carrying solenoid points strictly parallel to its central longitudinal axis. When an electron is shot along this axis, the angle $$\theta$$ between its velocity vector $$\vec{v}$$ and $$\vec{B}$$ is either $$0^{\circ}$$ or $$180^{\circ}$$. The magnetic Lorentz force resolves to zero ($$F = qvB\sin\theta = 0$$), allowing the particle to continue un-deflected with a uniform velocity.

qe: Which operational statement correctly details the continuous acceleration behavior experienced by a charged particle traversing inside a functional cyclotron?
qh: एक साइक्लोट्रॉन (cyclotron) के भीतर एक गतिशील आवेशित कण द्वारा अनुभव किए जाने वाले निरंतर त्वरण व्यवहार (acceleration behavior) का सही विवरण क्या है?
o: The particle undergoes continuous acceleration at all times due to alternating electric and static magnetic fields (कण हर समय त्वरित गति में रहता है)
The particle gains kinetic speed exclusively within the hollow interior of the dees
The particle decelerates sharply within the spacing gaps between the dees
The static magnetic field vectors alter the net particle speed inside the gaps
e: Explanation: A particle in a cyclotron is accelerated at all times. In the narrow gaps between the dees, the alternating electric field increases its linear speed. Inside the hollow metal dees, the static magnetic field applies a perpendicular force that keeps its speed constant but continuously changes its directional velocity vector, executing centripetal acceleration.

qe: A circular current loop of magnetic moment $M$ is placed inside a uniform external magnetic field $B$. What is the net work done to rotate this loop by 30 degrees about an axis perpendicular to its own plane?
qh: एक चुंबकीय आघूर्ण $M$ वाले वृत्ताकार लूप को बाहरी समान चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $B$ में रखा गया है। इस लूप को स्वयं के तल के लंबवत अक्ष (axis perpendicular to its own plane) के परितः 30 डिग्री घुमाने में किया गया शुद्ध कार्य क्या होगा?
o: The total work scales directly as the cross product magnitude $MB$
The net work done to execute this specific rotation is exactly zero (किया गया शुद्ध कार्य शून्य होता है)
The work done is calculated as $$\frac{\sqrt{3}MB}{2}$$ lines
The energy requirement matches a scalar index threshold of $$\frac{MB}{2}$$
e: Explanation: Rotating a planar loop about an axis perpendicular to its own face does not alter the spatial orientation of its magnetic dipole moment vector relative to the external magnetic field lines. Because the angle $$\theta$$ between $$\vec{M}$$ and $$\vec{B}$$ remains constant, the potential energy does not change ($$\Delta U = 0$$), meaning the net work done is zero.

qe: According to the Bohr atomic model, what statement describes the gyro-magnetic ratio ($$\frac{\mu_l}{l}$$) of an orbiting electron inside a Hydrogen atom?
qh: बोहर परमाणु मॉडल के अनुसार, एक हाइड्रोजन परमाणु के भीतर परिक्रमा करने वाले इलेक्ट्रॉन के जाइरो-चुंबकीय अनुपात (gyro-magnetic ratio) की विशेषता क्या है?
o: It expands exponentially with the principal quantum number $n$
It is a constant value independent of which specific orbit the electron occupies (कक्षा की संख्या से स्वतंत्र एक नियतांक होना)
It transitions into an unpredictable unstable vector across boundaries
It drops cleanly down to an absolute zero state when energy rises
e: Explanation: The gyro-magnetic ratio of an electron is defined as the ratio of its orbital magnetic dipole moment ($$\mu_l$$) to its orbital angular momentum ($l$). Vectorially expressed as $$\frac{\vec{\mu}_l}{\vec{l}} = -\frac{e}{2m_e}$$, this value depends solely on universal elementary constants (charge $e$ and mass $m_e$), making it identical for all orbits.

qe: A long straight wire carrying a steady current $I$ is placed in a uniform magnetic field $\vec{B}$ perpendicular to its length. Why does the magnetic force do no net work if the wire moves under its influence?
qh: एक स्थिर धारा $I$ वाले सीधे तार को उसके लंबवत एक समान चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $\vec{B}$ में रखा गया है। यदि तार इस बल के प्रभाव में गति करता है, तो चुंबकीय बल द्वारा कोई शुद्ध कार्य क्यों नहीं किया जाता है?
o: The magnetic force molecules undergo rapid breakdown loops
The magnetic Lorentz force vector is universally perpendicular to the charge displacement vector at every instant ($$\vec{F}_m \perp \vec{v}$$) (चुंबकीय बल का गति की दिशा के सदैव लंबवत होना)
The wire segments completely lose their vital phosphate groups
The force forces adjacent elements to combine into solid starches
e: Explanation: The magnetic Lorentz force acting on any moving charge carrier is defined by the cross product $$\vec{F} = q(\vec{v} \times \vec{B})$$. Because the force vector ($$\vec{F}$$) is fundamentally orthogonal to the velocity vector ($$\vec{v}$$), the mechanical power generated resolves to zero ($$P = \vec{F} \cdot \vec{v} = 0$$). Thus, magnetic fields cannot do work on individual or collective charge carriers.

qe: Two identical current-carrying coaxial loops carry equal currents $I$ in completely opposite senses. What occurs when a single closed Amperian loop $C$ passes through both of them exactly once?
qh: दो समान धारावाही समाक्षीय लूप (coaxial loops) विपरीत दिशाओं में समान धारा $I$ ले जाते हैं। जब एक बंद एम्पीरियन लूप $C$ दोनों में से एक बार गुजरता है, तो एम्पियर के नियम के अनुसार क्या सत्य है?
o: The line integral value scales directly as $$\oint \vec{B} \cdot \vec{d}l = 2\mu_0 I$$
The line integral $$\oint \vec{B} \cdot \vec{d}l$$ around the closed path $C$ resolves exactly to zero (लाइन इंटीग्रल का मान शून्य होना)
The magnetic field vector $$\vec{B}$$ vanishes completely at every spatial coordinate along $C$
The outcome changes properties dynamically based on loop pressure metrics
e: Explanation: According to Ampere's Circuital Law, the line integral of the magnetic field along a closed path equals $$\mu_0$$ times the net enclosed current ($$\oint \vec{B} \cdot \vec{d}l = \mu_0 I_{\text{enclosed}}$$). Since the coaxial loops carry equal currents in opposite directions, the net enclosed current is $$I - I = 0$$, forcing the line integral to resolve to zero.

qe: An electron enters a cubical space filled with uniform electric and magnetic fields with a velocity vector $\vec{v}$, while a positron enters via the opposite face with a velocity vector $-\vec{v}$. What physical behavior maps their mechanical acceleration profiles at this instant?
qh: एक इलेक्ट्रॉन $\vec{v}$ वेग से और एक पॉज़िट्रॉन विपरीत फलक से $-\vec{v}$ वेग से समान विद्युत और चुंबकीय क्षेत्रों से भरे क्यूब में प्रवेश करते हैं। इस क्षण उनके त्वरण (acceleration) की क्या स्थिति होगी?
o: The electric forces on both particles generate identical directional acceleration vectors
Both particles experience equal magnetic force magnitudes that induce identical acceleration magnitudes (दोनों कणों पर समान परिमाण का चुंबकीय बल और त्वरण लगना)
Both particles follow a single linear trajectory that ignores the field vectors
The combined center of mass is accelerated solely by the electric field matrix
e: Explanation: The magnetic Lorentz force is given by $$\vec{F}_m = q(\vec{v} \times \vec{B})$$. For the electron ($$q = -e$$, velocity $$\vec{v}$$), the force is $$-e(\vec{v} \times \vec{B})$$. For the positron ($$q = +e$$, velocity $-\vec{v}$), the force is $$+e(-\vec{v} \times \vec{B}) = -e(\vec{v} \times \vec{B})$$. Because they experience identical magnetic force vectors and share the same mass, their resulting accelerations are equal.

qe: Under which explicit combinations of field vectors can a charged particle continue to propagate with a constant, undisturbed velocity vector through a space?
qh: किन विशिष्ट परिस्थितियों के अंतर्गत एक आवेशित कण बिना किसी विक्षेप के एकसमान वेग (constant velocity) से गति करना जारी रख सकता है?
o: Only when the electric field is non-zero and the magnetic field is strictly zero

When both fields are zero ($$\vec{E} = 0, \vec{B} = 0$$), or when non-zero fields are arranged crosswise so their forces cancel out ($$\vec{F}_E + \vec{F}_B = 0$$) (क्षेत्रों का शून्य होना या उनके बलों का आपस में संतुलित होना)
When the electric field vector matches an unbranched polyolefin line layout
When the system forces the net dielectric constant to drop to absolute zero
e: Explanation: For a charged particle to maintain a constant velocity vector, the net Lorentz force acting on it must be zero ($$\vec{F} = q\vec{E} + q(\vec{v} \times \vec{B}) = 0$$). This occurs trivially if both fields are absent ($$\vec{E} = 0, \vec{B} = 0$$). Alternatively, if both fields are present but configured perpendicularly (crossed fields) such that the electric force exactly balances the magnetic force ($$eE = evB$$), the particle passes un-deflected.

qe: What specific organic compound functions as the initial monomer building block required to construct the synthetic rubber elastomer known as Neoprene?
qh: सिंथेटिक इलास्टोमर नियोप्रीन (Neoprene) जैसे का निर्माण करने के लिए आवश्यक मुख्य मोनोमर बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक के रूप में कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक अणु कार्य करता है?
o: Isoprene (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene)
Chloroprene (2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene) (क्लोरोप्रीन मोनोमर)
Acrylonitrile (prop-2-enonitrile)
Styrene (phenylethylene) vinyl aromatic
e: Explanation: Neoprene is a durable synthetic rubber produced by the linear addition polymerization of chloroprene monomers, chemically designated as 2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene.

qe: What unique conformational property provides long-term kinetic stability to colloidal dispersions, preventing single particles from colliding and precipitating?
qh: कौन सा अनूठा संरचनात्मक पैरामीटर कोलाइडल फैलाव (colloidal dispersions) को दीर्घकालिक गतिज स्थिरता प्रदान करता है, एकल कणों को आपस में टकराने और अवक्षेपित होने से रोकता है?
o: The random helix coiling of unbranched polyolefin branches
The presence of equal and similar electrical charges on all dispersed colloidal particles, causing mutual electrostatic repulsion (कणों पर समान विद्युत आवेश के कारण प्रतिकर्षण)
The complete conversion of all surface functional groups into volatile non-ionic ethers
The total presence of short-chain aromatic links that absorb moisture
e: Explanation: Colloidal particles carry a net electrical charge of the same sign. The resulting mutual electrostatic repulsion prevents the particles from aggregating into larger clusters when they collide, stabilizing the colloidal dispersion.

qe: What direct mechanical change occurs to the native protein architecture inside an egg white when it undergoes thermal coagulation upon boiling?
qh: जब एक अंडे की सफेदी को उबालने पर थर्मल जमावट (thermal coagulation) होती है, तो उसके भीतर की प्राकृतिक प्रोटीन संरचना में क्या सीधा यांत्रिक परिवर्तन होता है?
o: The covalent peptide linkages are broken, returning the protein to single units
The native hydrogen bonds are disrupted, causing structural globules to unfold and helices to uncoil, resulting in a loss of biological activity (विकृतीकरण या डिनेचुरेशन)
The carbon backbone converts into a volatile open-chain gas cloud
The functional domains are reduced to non-ionic starch granules
e: Explanation: Boiling an egg white introduces thermal stress that disrupts non-covalent hydrogen bonds and structural constraints. This causes the folded globular proteins to uncoil and denature, cross-linking randomly into an insoluble white mass.

qe: What is the correct mathematical expression used to calculate the degree of dissociation ($\alpha$) of a weak electrolyte from its molar conductivity values?
qh: इलेक्ट्रोलाइट मानों से कमजोर इलेक्ट्रोलाइट के विघटन की डिग्री ($\alpha$) की गणना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला सही गणितीय व्यंजक क्या है?
o: $\alpha = \Lambda_m \cdot \Lambda_m^\circ$
$\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$ (विघटन की डिग्री सूत्र)
$\alpha = \frac{\alpha \cdot 1000}{M}$
$\alpha = nF E^\circ_{cell}$
e: Explanation: The degree of dissociation ($\alpha$) of a weak electrolyte at a specific concentration is calculated as the ratio of its molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) to its limiting molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m^\circ$): $\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$.

qe: What is the core mathematical formula used to calculate the Molar Conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) of a solution from its specific conductivity ($\kappa$) and molarity ($M$) in standard laboratory units?
qh: मानक प्रयोगशाला इकाइयों में समाधान की विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) और मोलरिटी ($M$) से उसकी मोलर चालकता ($\Lambda_m$) की गणना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला मुख्य गणितीय सूत्र क्या है?
o: $\Lambda_m = \frac{M \cdot \kappa}{1000}$
$\Lambda_m = \frac{1000 \cdot \kappa}{M}$ (मोलर चालकता सूत्र)
$\Lambda_m = \kappa \cdot G^*$
$\Lambda_m = \frac{\kappa \cdot R}{M}$
e: Explanation: When conductivity $\kappa$ is measured in $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$ and concentration $M$ is in $\text{mol/L}$, the molar conductivity is calculated using the formula: $\Lambda_m = \frac{1000 \cdot \kappa}{M}$.

qe: Which specific organic compound is generated when a molecule of natural cane sugar (sucrose) undergoes acidic hydrolysis?
qh: जब प्राकृतिक गन्ने की चीनी (सुक्रोज) का एक अणु अम्लीय जलअपघटन से गुजरता है तो कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक उत्पन्न होता है?
o: Two identical units of D-galactose
An equimolar mixture of D-glucose and D-fructose (ग्लूकोज एवं फ्रुक्टोज मिश्रण)
Two units of highly branched amylopectin
One molecule of glycine and one molecule of aminocaproic acid
e: Explanation: Hydrolyzing the disaccharide sucrose breaks its internal glycosidic linkage, releasing an equimolar mixture of one D-glucose molecule and one D-fructose molecule.

qe: What happens to the structure of the cyclic monomer caprolactam when it is heated with water to generate Nylon-6?
qh: जब चक्रीय मोनोमर कैप्रोलैक्टम को नायलॉन-6 उत्पन्न करने के लिए पानी के साथ गर्म किया जाता है तो उसकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: It cross-links into a three-dimensional thermosetting network containing methylene bridges
It undergoes hydrolytic ring-opening cleavage to yield an open amino acid chain that polymerizes into a polyamide (रिंग-ओपनिंग जलअपघटन)
It undergoes oxidation into a dibasic dicarboxylic acid fragment
It forms insoluble precipitates via the common-ion effect
e: Explanation: Heating caprolactam with water at elevated temperatures breaks its internal cyclic amide bond. This ring-opening hydrolytic step yields $\varepsilon$-aminocaproic acid, which polymerizes into the linear polyamide chain of Nylon-6.

qe: What specific operational role does benzoyl peroxide assume when added to an alkene mixture during free-radical addition polymerization?
qh: मुक्त-कण जोड़ पॉलीमराइजेशन के दौरान एल्कीन मिश्रण में मिलाए जाने पर बेंज़ोयल पेरोक्साइड क्या विशिष्ट परिचालन भूमिका निभाता है?
o: It acts as a mechanical filler to increase the total density of the plastic block
It serves as a reaction initiator by undergoing homolytic cleavage to generate active free radicals (मुक्त मूलक आरंभक)
It functions as a chemical chemical inhibitor that immediately stops chain propagation
It clarifies the basification parameters of the solution via acid-base buffer mechanisms
e: Explanation: Benzoyl peroxide is thermally unstable and easily undergoes homolytic cleavage at its oxygen-oxygen single bond ($-O-O-$). This dissociation generates active phenyl free radicals that attack alkene monomers to initiate free-radical chain-growth polymerization.

qe: Which specific organic functional group is generated when the carboxyl group of one amino acid condenses with the amino group of an adjacent unit to build a protein?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक कार्यात्मक समूह तब उत्पन्न होता है जब एक अमीनो एसिड का कार्बोक्सिल समूह प्रोटीन बनाने के लिए आसन्न इकाई के अमीनो समूह के साथ संघनित होता है?
o: Glycosidic connection bridging rings together
Peptide linkage / Amide bond (पेप्टाइड बंध / एमाइड लिंक)
Phosphodiester coordinate bridge balancing frames
Sulfur disulfide cross-link system anchoring paths
e: Explanation: Combining the alpha-carboxyl group of one amino acid with the alpha-amino center of another eliminates a water molecule, establishing a covalent amide linkage ($-CONH-$) termed a peptide bond or peptide linkage.

qe: What happens to the structure of linear Novolac strands if they are mixed with excess formaldehyde gas and subjected to high thermal curing?
qh: यदि रैखिक नोवोलेक स्ट्रैंड्स को अतिरिक्त फॉर्मलाडेहाइड गैस के साथ मिला जाए और उच्च थर्मल क्यूरिंग के अधीन किया जाए तो उनकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: They break down into volatile liquid phenols via hydrolytic cleavage
They develop extensive covalent methylene cross-links, transforming the linear resin into the rigid thermosetting network Bakelite (क्रॉस-लिंक्ड बैकेलाइट नेटवर्क)
They convert into an unbranched biodegradable polyester chain configuration
They form an explicit water-soluble uncharged non-ionic surfactant lattice balanced by sodium
e: Explanation: Novolac is a linear condensation intermediate. Heating Novolac with excess formaldehyde introduces methylene linkages that cross-link the chains into a permanent three-dimensional network, creating the infusible thermosetting polymer Bakelite.

qe: What structural unit remains after a nucleotide monomer loses its terminal esterified phosphate group?
qh: एक न्यूक्लियोटाइड मोनोमर जब अपने एस्टरीकृत फॉस्फेट समूह को खो देता, तो कौन सी संरचनात्मक इकाई शेष बचती है?
o: A volatile aliphatic open-chain non-polar gas matrix
Nucleoside (न्यूक्लिओसाइड)
An active free-radical addition polymer initiator
A cross-linked three-dimensional network panel
e: Explanation: A nucleoside contains only a pentose sugar linked to a nitrogenous base. Adding a phosphate group to its 5'-position transforms it into a full nucleotide.

qe: Which strong covalent linkage connects consecutive nucleotide monomers together along a single-stranded DNA or RNA polymer chain?
qh: कौन सा मजबूत सहसंयोजक बंध डीएनए या आरएनए के एक एकल धागे (single strand) के साथ लगातार न्यूक्लियोटाइड मोनोमर्स को एक साथ जोड़ता है?
o: N-glycosidic link bridging rings together
3'-5' phosphodiester linkage (3'-5' फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंध)
Amide linkage systematically identical to a biological peptide bond
Sulfur disulfide cross-link bridge system anchoring paths
e: Explanation: Nucleotides polymerize into nucleic acid chains via 3'-5' phosphodiester linkages, where a phosphate group forms stable ester covalent bonds between the 3'-hydroxyl group of one sugar ring and the 5'-hydroxyl group of the next.

qe: What molecular architectural arrangement details the relative directionality of the twin strands forming a classic B-DNA double helix model?
qh: कौन सा आणविक संरचनात्मक विन्यास डीएनए डबल हेलिक्स मॉडल के भीतर दो पूरक धागों की सापेक्ष दिशात्मकता (relative directionality) का विवरण देता है?
o: They run parallel in the exact same 5' to 3' spatial direction
They exhibit anti-parallel polarity, where one strand runs 5' to 3' and the other runs 3' to 5' (प्रति-समानांतर ध्रुवता / anti-parallel)
They are arranged as separate open-chain unlinked carbohydrate blocks
They cross-link randomly into a single infusible thermosetting net plastic
e: Explanation: The twin strands of a DNA double helix run anti-parallel to one another. One strand is oriented in the 5' to 3' direction, while its complementary counter-strand features a reverse 3' to 5' alignment.

qe: What structural feature characterises the alpha-helix secondary structure of a protein, keeping the right-handed screw shape stable?
qh: कौन सी संरचनात्मक विशेषता एक प्रोटीन की alphas-हेलिक्स माध्यमिक संरचना की विशेषता है, जो दाहिने हाथ की पेंच जैसी आकृति को स्थिर रखती है?
o: Weak van der Waals forces acting uniformly across non-polar branches
Intramolecular hydrogen bonds formed between the N-H group of an amino acid residue and the carbonyl C=O group of an adjacent turn (N-H और C=O के बीच हाइड्रोजन बंध)
Reversible ester links that undergo rapid reduction with basic catalysts
Cationic quaternary nitrogen halide cross-linked coordination zones
e: Explanation: The helical conformation of an $\alpha$-helix is locked and stabilized by a dense network of regular hydrogen bonds. These form between the polar amide $N-H$ groups situated along one loop of the coiling backbone and the carbonyl $C=O$ functional groups of the adjacent turn.

qe: What precise sequence of structural parts represents the generic composition of a single nucleotide building block inside nucleic acid backbones?
qh: न्यूक्लिक एसिड बैकबोन के भीतर एकल न्यूक्लियोटाइड बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक की सामान्य संरचना का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाला सटीक अनुक्रम क्या है?
o: A long lipophilic carbon chain bound tightly to pure sulfur matrices
A pentose sugar molecule covalently linked to a heterocyclic base and an esterified phosphate group (शर्करा-बेस-फॉस्फेट असेंबली)
An aromatic polyol layer mixed with fuming formaldehyde syrup segments
A glycine residue bound via alternating amide and dicarboxylic bands
e: Explanation: A single nucleotide is composed of three covalently bound elements: a five-carbon pentose sugar (ribose or deoxyribose), a nitrogenous base attached to the C1' position of the sugar, and a phosphate group esterified to its C5' position.

qe: What unique physical structural characteristic of the DNA double helix is maintained by the specific pairing of purines with pyrimidines?
qh: डीएनए डबल हेलिक्स की कौन सी भौतिक संरचनात्मक विशेषता प्यूरीन और पिरिमिडीन के विशिष्ट युग्मन (pairing) द्वारा बनाए रखी जाती है?
o: The antiparallel nature of the two strands
Uniform width throughout the DNA helix (डीएनए की एकसमान चौड़ाई)
The semi-conservative mode of replication
Uniform length across all distinct DNA types
e: Explanation: Pairing a bulky purine with a smaller pyrimidine ensures that the distance between the two strands remains constant (approx. 20 Å), resulting in a uniform width across the entire length of the DNA helix.

qe: How do the net electric charges of DNA and histones differ when they associate to form nucleosomes?
qh: जब न्यूक्लियोसोम बनाने के लिए डीएनए और हिस्टोन जुड़ते हैं, तो उनके शुद्ध विद्युत आवेश (net electric charges) कैसे भिन्न होते हैं?
o: Both carry a net positive charge
Both carry a net negative charge
DNA is negative, and Histones are positive (डीएनए ऋणात्मक एवं हिस्टोन धनात्मक)
Both carry zero net charge
e: Explanation: DNA is negatively charged due to its phosphate backbone. Histones are rich in basic amino acids like lysine and arginine, which carry a net positive charge at physiological pH, allowing for tight electrostatic association.

qe: In the transcription unit, where are the promoter and terminator sites located relative to the coding strand?
qh: ट्रांसक्रिप्शन यूनिट में, कोडिंग धागे के सापेक्ष प्रमोटर (promoter) और टर्मिनेटर (terminator) साइटें कहाँ स्थित होती हैं?
o: Both are located at the 3' (downstream) end
Promoter is at the 5' (upstream) end, and Terminator is at the 3' (downstream) end (प्रमोटर 5' पर एवं टर्मिनेटर 3' पर)
Only the 5' end for both sites
Only the 3' end for both sites
e: Explanation: In a transcription unit, the promoter serves as the RNA polymerase binding site and is located at the 5' end (upstream) of the structural gene. The terminator defines the end of transcription and is located at the 3' end (downstream).

qe: Why is sickle-cell anaemia accurately classified as a 'molecular disease'?
qh: सिकल-सेल एनीमिया (sickle-cell anaemia) को 'आणविक रोग' (molecular disease) के रूप में सटीक रूप से क्यों वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Because it can be easily treated with high-dose iron supplements
Because it is caused by a specific point mutation in the beta-globin chain gene (बीटा-ग्लोबिन जीन में बिंदु उत्परिवर्तन)
Because it grants complete immunity to malaria infections
Because it is caused by viral capsid structural folding
e: Explanation: Sickle-cell anaemia is a genetic disorder caused by a single point mutation where the amino acid glutamate is replaced by valine at the sixth position of the beta-globin chain, making it a classic molecular disease.

qe: What functional properties define the relationship of the AUG codon in protein synthesis?
qh: प्रोटीन संश्लेषण में AUG कोडन (AUG codon) के संबंध में कौन से कार्यात्मक गुण सत्य हैं?
o: It codes for methionine, and it functions as an initiation codon (मिथियोनिन के लिए कोड करना एवं दीक्षा कोडन होना)
It codes for valine only
It is an exclusively stop codon for both prokaryotes and eukaryotes
It is ignored by ribosomes during the translation phase
e: Explanation: AUG is a dual-function codon: it specifies the amino acid methionine and serves as the universal initiation signal for protein synthesis in both prokaryotes and eukaryotes.

qe: What scientific evidence suggests that RNA was the first genetic material on Earth?
qh: कौन सा वैज्ञानिक साक्ष्य यह बताता है कि पृथ्वी पर आरएनए (RNA) पहली आनुवंशिक सामग्री थी?
o: Proteins evolved from RNA, but RNA lacks stability
Essential life processes, such as metabolism and translation, evolved around RNA, which acts as a catalyst (मेटाबोलिज्म एवं ट्रांसलेशन आरएनए के चारों ओर विकसित हुए)
DNA was formed from RNA via spontaneous mineral precipitation
RNA molecules consist of triple-stranded lattice configurations
e: Explanation: Current research suggests life processes like translation and metabolism evolved around RNA. RNA acts as both genetic material and a catalyst, though its reactivity makes it less stable than DNA.

qe: In eukaryotic mRNA maturation, which sequences remain in the final transcript?
qh: यूकैरियोटिक mRNA परिपक्वता (maturation) में, कौन से अनुक्रम अंतिम प्रतिलेख में बने रहते हैं?
o: Introns only
Exons only (केवल एक्सॉन)
Both introns and exons
Neither introns nor exons
e: Explanation: Eukaryotic genes are 'split', meaning they contain non-coding introns and coding exons. During processing, introns are removed (spliced out), and only the exons appear in the mature, processed mRNA.

qe: Which human chromosome possesses the highest count of functional genes, and which one contains the fewest?
qh: मानव गुणसूत्रों में से किसमें कार्यात्मक जीनों की संख्या सबसे अधिक और किसमें सबसे कम है?
o: Chromosome 1 (highest) and Y (lowest) (गुणसूत्र 1 सर्वाधिक, गुणसूत्र Y न्यूनतम)
Chromosome 11 (highest) and X (lowest)
Chromosome 21 (highest) and 1 (lowest)
Chromosome X (highest) and Y (lowest)
e: Explanation: Human Genome Project data revealed that Chromosome 1 harbors the highest number of genes (approx. 2968), whereas the Y chromosome has the fewest (approx. 231 genes).

qe: Which scientists utilized X-ray diffraction data to propose the double-helix DNA model in 1953?
qh: 1953 में डीएनए डबल हेलिक्स मॉडल प्रस्तावित करने के लिए किस वैज्ञानिक जोड़ी ने एक्स-रे विवर्तन डेटा (X-ray diffraction data) का उपयोग किया था?
o: Rosalind Franklin and Maurice Wilkins
James Watson and Francis Crick (वाटसन एवं क्रिक)
Erwin Chargaff and Arthur Kornberg
Meselson and Stahl
e: Explanation: James Watson and Francis Crick proposed the famous double helix model in 1953, utilizing X-ray diffraction data generated by Maurice Wilkins and Rosalind Franklin.

qe: Why must the 3'-OH group be removed or replaced when synthesizing artificial DNA strands to prevent uncontrolled polymerization?
qh: कृत्रिम डीएनए धागों को संश्लेषित करते समय अनियंत्रित पॉलीमराइजेशन को रोकने के लिए 3'-OH समूह को क्यों हटाया या प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए?
o: Because purines interfere with pyrimidines at the 3' end
Because DNA polymerase requires a free 3'-OH group to add new nucleotides; blocking it stops chain extension (3'-OH की अनुपस्थिति से पॉलीमराइजेशन रुक जाता है)
Because the phosphate group naturally blocks the 3' position
Because 2'-OH groups initiate explosive cleavage
e: Explanation: DNA polymerase synthesizes DNA by adding nucleotides to the free 3'-OH group of the growing strand. If the 3'-OH group is blocked or absent, the polymerase cannot add the next nucleotide, effectively stopping the polymerization reaction.

qe: Why does the synthesis of the DNA lagging strand proceed in a discontinuous fashion (Okazaki fragments)?
qh: डीएनए लैगिंग स्ट्रैंड (lagging strand) का संश्लेषण असतत तरीके (ओकाजाकी खंड) से क्यों होता है?
o: Because DNA molecules are too long to synthesize continuously
Because DNA polymerase can only catalyze polymerization in one direction (5' to 3') (DNA पॉलीमरेज की एकदिशीय प्रकृति)
Because the process is fundamentally inefficient in bacteria
Because DNA ligase needs to exert a mechanical force on the strands
e: Explanation: DNA polymerase only catalyzes synthesis in the 5' to 3' direction. Since the two parent strands are anti-parallel, one strand (leading) is synthesized continuously, while the other (lagging) must be synthesized in short, discontinuous segments known as Okazaki fragments.

qe: Which specific enzyme is responsible for the transcription process in prokaryotes?
qh: प्रोकैरियोट्स में ट्रांसक्रिप्शन (transcription) प्रक्रिया के लिए कौन सा विशिष्ट एंजाइम जिम्मेदार है?
o: DNA Ligase
DNA-dependent RNA polymerase (डीएनए-निर्भर आरएनए पॉलीमरेज)
Restriction endonuclease
Taq Polymerase
e: Explanation: In prokaryotes, a single type of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase is responsible for the transcription of all types of RNA (mRNA, tRNA, and rRNA).

qe: At what functional level does the regulation of gene expression primarily occur in eukaryotic systems?
qh: यूकैरियोटिक प्रणालियों में जीन अभिव्यक्ति (gene expression) का विनियमन प्राथमिक रूप से किस कार्यात्मक स्तर पर होता है?
o: During DNA replication
Transcriptional level, during the formation of primary transcripts (ट्रांसक्रिप्शनल स्तर पर)
During protein folding in the Golgi apparatus
None of these
e: Explanation: Gene expression in eukaryotes can be regulated at several levels, including transcriptional (primary transcript formation), processing (splicing), transport of mRNA, and translational levels.
